div.head: Romscot 2
div.ab: Gif hit hwa forgumie, gylde LX scill' ⁊ be twelffealdan agife þene Rómpenincg.
Wenn es jémand versäumt, zahle er 60 Schill. und entrichte den Rompfennig mit Zwölffachem.
If anyone neglects it, let him pay 60 shillings and render the Rome-penny twelvefold.
If anyone misses [this date], he should pay [a fine of] 60 shillings, and pay twelve times [the Peter's pence].

note.label: term recurs
note.quote: the 'Rompenincg' of Romscot 2 recurs in Northu 57:1

div.note: U: translator unrecorded: check; In G, Iudex follows in the same hand.

note.seg: Öffentliches Strafgeld; anders Gl Peterspfennig 17. Vielleicht erklärt sich diese Summe als das von Ine 4 für Vorenthaltung des Kirchenpfennigs angedrohte Strafgeldfixum; s. d. 12. a
A public fine; differently in Gl Peterspfennig 17. Perhaps this sum is to be explained as the fixed fine threatened by Ine 4 for withholding church-scot; see that word 12. a
Auch diese Busse für die Kirche regeln alle Gesetze über Peterspfennig anders; dageg. jenes Gesetz Ines ebenso: LX scill. ⁊ be twelffealdum agife þone
This compensation to the church, too, is regulated differently by all the laws on Peter's Pence; that law of Ine, on the other hand, has it in the same way: LX scill. ⁊ be twelffealdum agife þone
